5578-the-burgomaster-s-wife-volume-01.title: The Burgomaster S Wife Volume 01
5578-the-burgomaster-s-wife-volume-01.creator: Georg Ebers
5578-the-burgomaster-s-wife-volume-01.description: A book by Georg Ebers. eside one of the numerous ditches intersecting the wide plain stood a stork, snapping at a fine frog; the poor fellow soon writhed in its enemy's red beak. One gulp--the merry jumper vanished, and its murderer, flapping its wings, soared high into the air.

60829-the-upside-down-captain.title: The Upside Down Captain
60829-the-upside-down-captain.creator: Unknown
60829-the-upside-down-captain.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Wouldn't it be just like the old timers to let him stand around and let the ship take off without him, all because he hadn't followed the proper procedure--a procedure he couldn't know? All he had been instructed to do was "report to the _Gorgon_." How do you report to a spaceship? Say, "Hello, spaceship?" Speak to the captain? And where did he find them?

arxiv-2009-07404.title: Cell A* for Navigation of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles in Partially-known Environments
arxiv-2009-07404.creator: Wenjian Hao, Rongyao Wang, Alexander Krolicki, Yiqiang Han
arxiv-2009-07404.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Wenjian Hao, Rongyao Wang, Alexander Krolicki, Yiqiang Han. Proper path planning is the first step of robust and efficient autonomous navigation for mobile robots. Meanwhile, it is still challenging for robots to work in a complex environment without complete prior information. This paper presents an extension to the A* search algorithm and its variants to make the path planning stable with less computational burden while handling long-distance tasks.

arxiv-2102-01141.title: Forecasting High-Frequency Spatio-Temporal Wind Power with Dimensionally Reduced Echo State Networks
arxiv-2102-01141.description: Abstract Fast and accurate hourly forecasts of wind speed and power are crucial in quantifying and planning the energy budget in the electric grid. Modeling wind at a high resolution brings forth considerable challenges given its turbulent and highly nonlinear dynamics.

arxiv-2109-05678.title: Colour and baryon number fluctuation of preconfinement system in production process and T c ​ c T_{cc} structure
arxiv-2109-05678.creator: Yi Jin, Shi-Yuan Li, Yan-Rui Liu, Qin Qin, Zong-Guo Si, Fu-Sheng Yu
arxiv-2109-05678.description: Abstract We suggest to study the production mechanism and some details of the production properties to probe the structure of the D ​ D ​ π DD\pi resonance T c ​ c + T_{cc}^{+} recently observed by the LHCb Collaboration.

arxiv-2110-03238.title: Liouville Theorems for holomorphic maps on pseudo-Hermitian manifolds
arxiv-2110-03238.creator: Haojie Chen, Yibin Ren
arxiv-2110-03238.description: Abstract . We prove some Liouville type results for generalized holomorphic maps in three classes: maps from pseudo-Hermitian manifolds to almost Hermitian manifolds, maps from almost Hermitian manifolds to pseudo-Hermitian manifolds and maps from pseudo-Hermitian manifolds to pseudo-Hermitian manifolds, assuming that the domains are compact.

arxiv-2408-11396.title: MoE-LPR: Multilingual Extension of Large Language Models through Mixture-of-Experts with Language Priors Routing
arxiv-2408-11396.creator: Hao Zhou Zhijun Wang Shujian Huang, Xin Huang Xue Han Junlan Feng Chao Deng Weihua Luo Jiajun Chen
arxiv-2408-11396.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Hao Zhou Zhijun Wang Shujian Huang, Xin Huang Xue Han Junlan Feng Chao Deng Weihua Luo Jiajun Chen. Large Language Models (LLMs) are often English-centric due to the disproportionate distribution of languages in their pre-training data. Enhancing non-English language capabilities through post-pretraining often results in catastrophic forgetting of the ability of original languages. Previous methods either achieve good expansion with severe forgetting or slight forgetting with poor expansion, indicating the challenge of balancing language expansion while preventing forgetting.

arxiv-2505-10247.title: Correlations of Q β Q_{\beta} -values with symmetry energy and effective mass studied within Skyrme energy–density functionals
arxiv-2505-10247.creator: Futoshi Minato, Yifei Niu, Kenichi Yoshida
arxiv-2505-10247.description: Abstract Background The β \beta -decay half-lives of nuclei are sensitive to the values of Q β Q_{\beta} . For accurate theoretical predictions, it is essential to develop an effective interaction or an energy density functional (EDF) that can systematically reproduce experimental Q β Q_{\beta} values.

arxiv-2505-11055.title: Internal Effectful Forcing in System T
arxiv-2505-11055.creator: Martín H. Escardó, Bruno da Rocha Paiva, Vincent Rahli, Ayberk Tosun
arxiv-2505-11055.description: Abstract The effectful forcing technique allows one to show that the denotation of a closed System T term of type ( ι ⇒ ι ) ⇒ ι (\iota\Rightarrow\iota)\Rightarrow\iota in the set-theoretical model is a continuous function ( ℕ → ℕ ) → ℕ (\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N})\to\mathbb{N} .

arxiv-2506-15588.title: Memory-Efficient Differentially Private Training with Gradient Random Projection
arxiv-2506-15588.creator: Alex Mulrooney, Devansh Gupta, James FlemingsHuanyu Zhang, [0.5ex] Murali Annavaram, Meisam Razaviyayn, Xinwei Zhang, [1ex] University of Delaware
arxiv-2506-15588.description: Abstract Differential privacy (DP) protects sensitive data during neural network training, but standard methods like DP-Adam suffer from high memory overhead due to per-sample gradient clipping, limiting scalability. We introduce DP-GRAPE (Gradient RAndom ProjEction), a DP training method that significantly reduces memory usage while maintaining utility on par with first-order DP approaches.

arxiv-2508-15380.title: Almost and Approximate EFX for Few Types of Agents
arxiv-2508-15380.creator: Vishwa Prakash HV Ruta Mehta Chennai Mathematical Institute University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign vishwa@cmi.ac.in rutameht@illinois.edu Prajakta Nimbhorkar Chennai Mathematical Institute prajakta@cmi.ac.in
arxiv-2508-15380.description: Abstract We study the problem of fair allocation of a set of indivisible goods among n n agents with k k distinct additive valuations, with the goal of achieving approximate envy-freeness up to any good ( α ​ - ​ EFX \alpha\text{-}\mathrm{EFX} ).

arxiv-2601-05141.title: Superluminal modes in a quantum field simulator for cosmology from analog Transplanckian physics
arxiv-2601-05141.creator: Christian F. Schmidt, Stefan Floerchinger
arxiv-2601-05141.description: Abstract The quantum-field-theoretic description for the U(1)-Goldstone boson of a scalar Bose-Einstein condensate with time-dependent contact interactions is developed beyond the acoustic approximation in accordance with Bogoliubov theory. The resulting effective action is mapped to a relativistic quantum field theory on a dispersive (or rainbow) cosmological spacetime which has a superluminal Corley-Jacobson dispersion relation.

arxiv-2602-14441.title: D-SECURE: Dual-Source Evidence Combination for Unified Reasoning in Misinformation Detection
arxiv-2602-14441.creator: Gagandeep Singh*, Samudi Amarasinghe*, Priyanka Singh
arxiv-2602-14441.description: Abstract Multimodal misinformation increasingly mixes realistic image edits with fluent but misleading text, producing persuasive posts that are difficult to verify. Existing systems usually rely on a single evidence source. Content-based detectors identify local inconsistencies within an image and its caption but cannot determine global factual truth.

europmc-pmc5124260.title: The Oxford Nanopore MinION: delivery of nanopore sequencing to the genomics community.
europmc-pmc5124260.creator: Jain M, Olsen HE, Paten B, Akeson M.
europmc-pmc5124260.description: Nanopore DNA strand sequencing has emerged as a competitive, portable technology. Reads exceeding 150 kilobases have been achieved, as have in-field detection and analysis of clinical pathogens. We summarize key technical features of the Oxford Nanopore MinION, the dominant...

pmc-10670438.title: Global Cardiac Surgery—Accessibility to Cardiac Surgery in Developing Countries: Objectives, Challenges, and Solutions
pmc-10670438.creator: Salvatore Agati, Ermanno Bellanti
pmc-10670438.description: Cardiac surgery is a modern science in the history of medicine. The impact of cardiac disease, in terms of treatment and prognosis, has made this discipline indispensable to global health. In recent decades, the greatest investment has been dispensed to technological and material improvements to increase life expectancy.

pmc-10736215.title: PSYCHOMETRIC PROPERTIES OF THE CHANGING TALK ONLINE TRAINING PROGRAM EVALUATION SCALE FOR LONG-TERM CARE STAFF
pmc-10736215.creator: Frances Yang, Carissa Coleman, Clarissa Shaw, Yelena Perkhounkova, Maria Hein, Kristine Williams
pmc-10736215.description: The Changing Talk (CHAT) intervention educates long-term care staff about elderspeak and person-centered communication strategies. The online version of CHAT training is a national trial to reduce behavioral symptoms in long-term care residents with Alzheimer’s Disease and other dementias. The development and validation of program evaluation scales are important for ensuring valid intervention evaluation.

pmc-11398049.title: Methods and Software Tools for Reliable Operation of Flying LiFi Networks in Destruction Conditions
pmc-11398049.creator: Herman Fesenko, Oleg Illiashenko, Vyacheslav Kharchenko, Kyrylo Leichenko, Anatoliy Sachenko, Lukasz Scislo, Raffaele Bruno
pmc-11398049.description: The analysis of utilising unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to form flying networks in obstacle conditions and various algorithms for obstacle avoidance is conducted. A planning scheme for deploying a flying LiFi network based on UAVs in a production facility with obstacles is developed and described.

pmc-11643868.title: Somatic Changes of Maternal High-Fat Diet on Offspring—Possible Deleterious Effects of Flavonoids?
pmc-11643868.creator: Cristina Mihaela Ormindean, Razvan Ciortea, Carmen Elena Bucuri, Andrei Mihai Măluțan, Cristian Ioan Iuhas, Ciprian Gheorghe Porumb, Renata Lacramioara Nicula, Vlad Ormindean, Maria Patricia Roman, Ionel Daniel Nati, Viorela Suciu, Adrian Florea, Carolina Solomon, Madalina Moldovan, Dan Mihu, Annunz
pmc-11643868.description: Background/Objectives: The rapidly increasing rate of obesity has become an extremely important public health problem, particularly in developed countries. Obesity is associated with a range of health problems, often referred to as the metabolic syndrome. Adipose tissue is now regarded as an endocrine organ responsible for the hormonal secretion of adipokines, which are cytokines involved in various physiological processes.

pmc-11644205.title: Landsat-Derived Forel–Ule Index in the Three Gorges Reservoir over the Past Decade: Distribution, Trend, and Driver
pmc-11644205.creator: Yao Wang, Lei Feng, Jingan Shao, Menglan Gan, Meiling Liu, Ling Wu, Botian Zhou, Assefa M Melesse
pmc-11644205.description: Water color is an essential indicator of water quality assessment, and thus water color remote sensing has become a common method in large-scale water quality monitoring. The satellite-derived Forel–Ule index (FUI) can actually reflect the comprehensive water color characterization on a large scale; however, the spatial distribution and temporal trends in water color and their drivers remain prevalently elusive.

pmc-11826041.title: Contrasting income-based inequalities in incidence and mortality of breast cancer in Korea, 2006-2015
pmc-11826041.creator: Jinwook Bahk, Hee-Yeon Kang, Young-Ho Khang, Kyunghee Jung-Choi
pmc-11826041.description: OBJECTIVESBreast cancer incidence and mortality rates in Korea are increasing. This study analyzed income-based inequalities in the incidence and mortality of women breast cancer from 2006 to 2015, using national data that covered all Korean women.METHODSWe used the National Health Information Database from 2006 to 2015.

pmc-12463636.title: Enhancing diagnostics through flow cytometry: overcoming barriers in low resource settings
pmc-12463636.creator: Jeanine Alfaro, Patricia Valverde, Paola Salguero, Xiomara Arevalo, Pamela Ortega, Luisa Sanchez, Federico Antillon-Klussmann, Randall T. Hayden, Alicia Rodriguez, Monika L. Metzger, John K. Choi, Victor M. Santana, Paul E. Mead, Priya Kumar
pmc-12463636.description: Despite advancements in the treatment of acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL), survival rates vary greatly based on factors such as cancer subtype and geographical location. The use of diagnostic tools like immunophenotyping and measurable residual disease (MRD) detection by flow cytometry (FC) are key to optimal management.

pmc-12610724.title: Time-Frequency-Based Separation of Earthquake and Noise Signals on Real Seismic Data: EMD, DWT and Ensemble Classifier Approaches
pmc-12610724.creator: Yunus Emre Erdoğan, Ali Narin, Elena Ascari
pmc-12610724.description: Highlights What are the main findings? Time-frequency features extracted using EMD, DWT, and combined EMD+DWT effectively separate earthquake and noise signals.Random Forest classifier with Lasso-selected EMD+DWT features achieved 100% accuracy, specificity, and sensitivity. What are the implication of the main findings? Time-frequency-based feature extraction and selection improve real-time earth-quake detection.

pmc-12747891.title: A Preoperative Scoring System Based on Clinical Characteristics and Hematologic Parameters for Differentiating Uterine Leiomyosarcoma from Leiomyoma
pmc-12747891.creator: Yuanqiu Wang, Xiaowan Huang, Ruilong Yu, Siyu Yang, Ying Su
pmc-12747891.description: PurposePreoperative diagnosis of uterine leiomyosarcoma (ULMS) can be difficult due to its ability to mimic benign leiomyomas (LM). The current study aimed to investigate the influence of preoperative clinical characteristics and hematologic parameters on preoperative diagnosis and to design a scoring system.

pmc-12838720.title: Integrated Microfluidic Giant Magnetoresistance (GMR) Biosensor Platform for Magnetoresistive Immunoassay of Myoglobin
pmc-12838720.creator: Yikai Wang, Huaiyu Wang, Yunyun Zhang, Shuhui Cui, Fei Hu, Bo’an Li
pmc-12838720.description: Acute myocardial infarction (AMI) is a rapidly progressing cardiovascular condition associated with high mortality. Myoglobin is an early biomarker of AMI; however, its detection using conventional methods is limited by complex workflows and low resistance to interference. In this study, we developed an integrated myoglobin detection platform that combined magneto-immunoassay with microfluidic technology.

pmc-13526219.title: Novel Therapeutic Strategies and Biomarkers in the Management of Inflammatory Bowel Disease: A Narrative Review
pmc-13526219.creator: Zechariah Kandathil, Arif Raihan, Thivian Mathanaruban

pmc-13575493.title: Reward Prediction Errors Drive Reinforcement Learning and Recognition Memory: Gender Differences in Methamphetamine Abusers
pmc-13575493.creator: YuQing Liu, Die Wang, LePing Wang, SongSong Wang, ZhiYing Chen, Tiancheng Wang, Shengyi Jin, Qiang Zhou, Liping Yang
pmc-13575493.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectivesMethamphetamine (MA) abusers have impaired executive functioning with gender differences, which may be related to the reward prediction errors (RPEs) that drive reinforcement learning and recognition memory, as RPE signaling is impaired in MA abusers.

uslaw-usc-t18-s1713.title: 18 U.S.C. § 1713 — Issuance of money orders without payment
uslaw-usc-t18-s1713.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t18-s1713.description: United States Code, Title 18 (Crimes And Criminal Procedure); Part I (Crimes); Chapter 83 (Postal Service). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Whoever, being an officer or employee of the Postal Service, issues a money order without having previously received the money therefor, shall be fined under this title.
